# Pinned sources and inherited terms

[LICENSING.md](../LICENSING.md) owns the project grant, attribution, dependency obligations and [release decisions](../LICENSING.md#release-decisions). Original software is `AGPL-3.0-only`; inherited material retains its own terms. jitl (justjake) and x70view receive primary credit for the inherited emulator. jitl explicitly permitted redistribution on 2026-10-14 provided he is credited; this is not an author-provided AGPL or other SPDX license.

[The source manifest](../manifests/sources.json) records exact commits and scoped evidence. Inspect imports and build scripts before execution; a pin or inventory is not a completed audit. Keep upstream notices and local modifications explicit. Acquired checkouts, firmware, ROM, captures and runtime outputs remain outside source control except individually recorded scoped fixture dispositions.

| Record | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Dependency license declarations](dependency-licenses.json) | All locked Bazel modules and native Cargo registry packages, plus selected locked Nix package declarations, with primary evidence and audit limits |
| [Retained license texts](licenses/) | rules_haskell Apache-2.0 terms and the fffw MIT copyright/permission notice; not replacement terms for other upstream material |
| [Transport/protocol and native effects](../reports/source-and-transport-audit.md) | ff80 source digests, [selected libusb/libudev inventory](native-usb-source-inventory.json), reviewed kernel commit/profile |
| [Firmware/export/recovery](../reports/firmware-extraction.md) | [Selected exact firmware/boot/patcher source metadata](firmware-source-inventory.json), without firmware bytes |

Whole-tree fffw/python-libusb1 inventories are reproducible from the manifest's commits with `//third_party:source-inventory`; [tool arguments](../reports/review/README.md) describe regeneration. The tool reads Git objects without importing or executing upstream code. These metadata inventories are not permission to redistribute a source archive or proprietary inputs.

Only the exact inspected patcher header/complement path is executed through the bounded exporter. CLI/assembler/updater/camera paths are excluded. Fujihack's sibling examples supply no X-M1 port or map. Reference-only algorithm inputs still need commit selection and a scoped audit before source reuse.

## Retained x70view closure

`emulation/xm1-upstream/` preserves a selected runtime closure from jitl (justjake)'s [x70view](https://github.com/justjake/x70view) commit `40406daf52228ace99cb1a3e322f3193f96b0283`, with X-M1 adaptations. Its native package retains upstream names. The [reference assessment](../reports/x70-emulator-reference.md#12-the-authors-grant) preserves the initial 2026-10-09 personal permission and the 2026-10-14 explicit redistribution permission conditioned on credit. The [emulation report](../reports/full-system-emulation.md#119-interactive-x-m1-application-emulation) records target execution scope. The public upstream pin remains unavailable. No author-provided SPDX license, sublicensing authority or downstream modification terms were supplied; do not relabel this inherited implementation AGPL. These scope questions do not negate the redistribution grant.

### Exact-source recovery boundary

Both original commit and root-tree objects survive privately. Commit `40406daf52228ace99cb1a3e322f3193f96b0283` names root tree `91858607f056ba2790b129777b6602b0943970c9`; the separate matching-toolchain pin `62876536052549cbcba1e9f6abc1437e773dba2f` names root tree `0c2a6de5506c3d008407ab1cb2558f4770ac5cdd`. Reading and rehashing those commit and root-tree objects reproduces their Git identities. This is a local identity check, not a publicly recoverable upstream archive.

Public recovery checks on 2026-10-26 found no exact source route: GitHub's original repository, commit, patch and pinned codeload archive return 404, as does the second pin's archive. GitHub's public repository-name and exact-commit searches return zero results, and FujiMod's commit API does not resolve the original commit. Software Heritage's exact origin and original revision endpoints return 404. Wayback's availability API lists no snapshot for the original commit or codeload archive; its broader CDX request returned 503. These bounded observations do not prove that no other mirror or archive exists.

What remains unavailable to an independent public reader is an immutable original-source archive, or exact source patches with integrity records tying the relevant retained files to the original revisions. The privately retained Git objects and this repository's adapted source closure do not supply that public recovery route. No replacement checkout or FujiMod revision is an equivalent original identity. Preserve both manifest pins; recovered source must be matched against them rather than silently substituted.

The retained `native/Cargo.toml`, `native/Cargo.lock` and `native/build.rs` are byte-identical Git blobs to those at the original runtime pin. The retained `build-support/exr2-gcc/host-qsort.c` is likewise identical to `decomp/toolchain/macos/host-qsort.c` at the matching-toolchain pin. The native Cargo dependencies remain PyO3 `0.29.3` and libloading `0.9.0` with registry checksums in the retained lockfile. The selected Python environment comes from locked Nix packages in `devenv.nix`, not the original full research `uv.lock`. The original runtime's `native/unicorn` gitlink is `9e42f34006b10ad67f3cfed7cc5c7ab2209a53b3`, which resolves in the public [Unicorn repository](https://github.com/justjake/unicorn/commit/9e42f34006b10ad67f3cfed7cc5c7ab2209a53b3); the currently selected engine is the separately recorded `ecf0e25a` pin below. This comparison binds selected retained dependency metadata, not every upstream file or a combined-artifact licence.

These findings are recorded in `E-X70VIEW-SOURCE-RECOVERY-BOUNDARY`. Public exact-source recovery remains unestablished; the fallback disposition is the explicit missing archive/patch-set contract above, not a claim of global impossibility.

### Retained inputs and dependencies

The owner chose on 2026-10-14 to retain the exact sixteen-byte remembered MCU packet in `emulation/xm1-upstream/emulator/captured_mcu_profile.py` publicly as a scoped observed fixture. It is not synthetic data, and this disposition is not permission to redistribute other Fujifilm firmware or captures.

Unicorn implementation code is not vendored, but the bounded runner links its engine and the retained native viewer loads it in-process. The locked Nix engine is Unicorn 2.1.4, declared `GPL-2.0-only`; header or binding terms do not relicense the engine. Assess compatibility for actual combinations, distributed linked/load-in-process binaries, bundled Nix closures and deployed services. A flake reference alone neither redistributes the engine nor automatically clears or blocks source-only publication. PyO3, libloading and their transitive Cargo terms are recorded in the dependency metadata; preserve their notices when conveying dependency code or linked artifacts.

The X-M1 viewer loads jitl (justjake)'s public Unicorn fork at `ecf0e25a2a4c308655e30e1d3198d148c4fc0819` (branch `embedder`, 2026-10-22) from `https://github.com/justjake/unicorn`, built by `build-support/unicorn-x70.nix` (ARM-only, tests disabled, source NAR hash pinned). It is Unicorn 2.1.4 plus 27 commits, 26 by jitl and one by Josef Miegl (`586dd3b2`, merged as pull request 1), that change 46 files to add the `uc_embedder_*` exports the retained native engine loads, an opt-in parallel-TCG mode, an asynchronous pause field and an optional TCI/Wasm backend. `COPYING` and the other license files are unchanged from 2.1.4; the patches add no separate notice, and the new TCI files carry their QEMU notices (`qemu/tcg/tci.c` GPL-2.0-or-later, `qemu/tcg/tci/` MIT), which the ARM JIT build does not compile. The previous pin `f12467851d10175cd2856089c39c7e561c9cb25e` exported the same functions as `uc_x70_*`. x70view pinned `ce7c0d5ab72e52f9150d94513647323e9d02d995` at `a47591d9bd` and retired its `native/unicorn` gitlink in `4a1e38c209`. The bounded C runner and Python binding remain on stock Nix Unicorn.

## FujiMod reference source

`manifests/sources.json` pins jitl (justjake)'s [FujiMod](https://github.com/justjake/FujiMod) at `ecdb6cb653ca0fa3372e4a4cf92c88bffa13ae29` as a reference source. jitl has stated FujiMod will be AGPL; no licence file at the pinned commit yet. The eventual grant's version and coverage of Josef Miegl's contributions remain to be established ([licensing item 7](../LICENSING.md#release-decisions)). `build-support/fujimod.nix` fetches it with submodules by commit and builds `fujimod-emulator` locally; nothing from it is vendored or conveyed. The build applies `build-support/fujimod-unicorn-context-align.patch`, which aligns `struct uc_context`'s data to 16 bytes in the vendored Unicorn (`0c0e055c8895cf3c38aa751a57e5895508d8393f`).
